result.title: NBCLT: Parameter-Agnostic Norm-Ball Clipped Local Training
result.summary: Distributed learning with multiple local steps reduces communication but aggravates drift, and its practical performance often depends on carefully tuned hyperparameters under heterogeneous data and communication constraints. At the same time, recent Muon-type optimizers suggest that constraining updates within suitable norm balls provides a simple way to encode geometric priors into optimization. In this work, we propose NBCLT (Norm-Ball Clipped Local Training), a unified local-training framework for both federated learning (FL) and decentralized learning (DL). NBCLT combines a predict-and-correct local update rule with Euclidean projections onto flexible norm balls, thereby performing norm-ball clipping under flexible update geometries while retaining a simple implementation. In FL, its problem-parameter-free regime achieves $\mathcal{O}(ε^{-2})$ communication complexity and $\mathcal{O}(ε^{-4})$ total stochastic-gradient complexity without assuming bounded heterogeneity, when the per-round local-computation budget is scaled appropriately with the horizon. In DL, NBCLT is compatible with both static and time-varying mixing and preserves these accuracy exponents under the analogous computation scaling, up to fixed network constants and an additive initialization cost.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 NBCLT，一个统一用于联邦学习与去中心化学习的本地训练框架：把「预测—校正」式本地更新与灵活的 norm-ball 欧氏投影结合，实现无需问题相关超参的更新裁剪，并给出通信与随机梯度复杂度界。
AI.relevance_reason: 其中的 norm-ball 投影约束与「预测—校正」更新规则，可能为 latent/循环推理中多次迭代的状态更新漂移控制与几何约束提供可核查的借鉴线索，但原文面向分布式优化，是否可迁移到推理期 latent 状态演化尚需核对。
